about: HKS handover gates. hks_gates and hks_handover read kind, direction, line and status from here. Evidence: projects/hks/gates/backtest.md; mistakes: failure-table.md. Rules for the lifecycle: README.md.

late_draft_policy_options.label: a failed control may reach the user only if the handover opens with its id and value
late_draft_policy_options.block: a failed control never reaches the user

override_policy: agent or user, each with a written reason (--override GATE="reason" --by <who>); every override is a line in overrides.jsonl and must be named in the handover. Decided by the user 2026-11-25.

same_frame_share.mistake: the cut shows: sound and picture cut on the same frame, no cover (K7a, K11, K23)
same_frame_share.evidence: user finals 0.066-0.451 (11 tuning days, median 0.168; numerator and denominator both end at the show end); holdouts 1002 0.184, 1109 0.133, 1118 0.203 pass; drafts caught 1124 v2 0.696, 1125 v1 0.705; flagged with no user verdict 1124 v1 0.955 (the agent itself called it 'has jump cuts'); missed 1123 v4 0.371 (near_miss_covers catches it)

near_miss_covers.mistake: a cover starts or ends 1-4 frames off the sound cut, so the jump flashes (K7a)
near_miss_covers.evidence: user finals 0.006-0.056 (median 0.019); holdouts 0.044, 0.009, 0.049 pass; caught 1123 v4 0.20 (the red-marked jump cut; its fix v5 is 0.0); flagged 1123 v2 0.068 with no user verdict; a correlate with one positive: it excludes cuts where the picture also cuts on the sound cut, which is the 20:59 diagnosis of v4 (those count in same_frame_share)

source_repeats.mistake: two neighbouring pieces overlap in source, so words play twice (K27)
source_repeats.evidence: 0 on all 14 user finals; caught 1125 v1 as saved at 19:34: 4 overlaps (382.71, 731.93, 2348.35, 4288.43; data/20261125-v1-1934-a1.json); 0 on every other draft

draft_labels.mistake: draft pieces carry no label colour (K6)
draft_labels.evidence: user finals 0.949-1.0; caught 1123 v1 and v2 (0.0); missed 1123 v3 (1.0 in the saved project now; the user may have labelled it after the correction); line 0.95 -> 0.949 on 2026-11-26: the 1110 final measures 0.949 and failed 0.95 (mutation test, output/hks_rules/mutation)

day_setup.mistake: the day's set-up skipped: Editing not split or labelled, no yellow must-keep marks, Backup empty (K1, K9, K10, K26)
day_setup.evidence: fails the user's own days: Backup empty on 1001, 1002, 1012, 1118; no Editing on 1012, 1020; no yellow on 1117. Caught 1123-1125 'no yellow' (agent set-up). Not a control until the user says which parts are every day's.

visible_cuts_in_speech.mistake: a visible cut in running speech (hks_cut_check list)
visible_cuts_in_speech.evidence: user finals list 4-27 each; a list to look at, never a line (rules.md mistake 5)

unsafe_holds.mistake: a J/L hold shows someone talking without their sound (hks_cut_check list)
unsafe_holds.evidence: user finals list 1-16 each; look at the frames of each

endings_reviewer.evidence: cold reviewer on piece-end text, blind. Cohen's kappa vs the user: 1125 v1 -0.15 (Sonnet), -0.06 (Opus), n=30; 1124 v4 0.13, 0.07, n=58; visible ends only 0.07, 0.04. Flags 22-60% of the user's own ends. Code proxy (continuation word) kappa -0.06/-0.01. Retired 2026-11-25: text without sound can't judge an ending the user judges by ear.

setup_reviewer.mistake: the story opens with no set-up for a first-time viewer (K21)
setup_reviewer.evidence: cold reviewer on the first 3.5 min of transcript, blind, Sonnet: setup_ok false on all 14 user finals and all 11 drafts (HKS opens cold by design). Retired 2026-11-25.

jump_cuts_framediff.evidence: same-frame cuts with source frame difference < 20 at the same framing: user finals 0-4, so the line is 4; drafts 1123 v1 11, v3 9, 1124 v1 6 flagged with no verdict; missed 1123 v4 (2) and 1125 v1 (3). Precision 0, recall 0. Retired 2026-11-25.
